info.title: Table
info.description: Tables held on wiki pages as `table` items — CSV, TSV, a markdown pipe table or JSON typed into the item, or data pushed through the write door. These operations read the first table item on a page (the json plugin's rule), list a site's tables, hand the data back as CSV, and — gated — replace a table's pushed data. The plugin's own server keeps json-plugin parity at /plugin/table/{slug}: an open GET and an X-Api-Key PUT for headless writers.

rows.description: Cells as strings, in column order.

records.description: The same rows as objects keyed by column, numbers coerced.

format.description: csv, tsv, gfm, json, resource or empty.

source.description: text (typed into the item) or resource (pushed through the write door).

written.description: Epoch ms of the last push.

interval.description: Ms between the last two pushes.

get.description: The first table item on the page, parsed: columns, rows as strings, the same rows as records, the caption and layout directives, and the push bookkeeping if data was written through a door.

404.description: No such page, or no table item on it.

get.description: Every page on the site you asked at whose story carries a table item, with its size and where its data came from.
The same first table item, serialised as RFC 4180 CSV inside a JSON envelope. For a bare text/csv response use the plugin's own GET /plugin/table/{slug}.csv.

404.description: No such page, or no table item on it.

post.summary: Push data into a page's table
post.description: Replace the pushed data (`resource`) of the first table item on the page. The typed text of the item is left alone and keeps supplying the caption and layout; pushed data wins over typed data when both exist. Gated by the farm: sign in as the site's owner, private sites only unless the farm allows public writes. Headless writers with an api key use PUT /plugin/table/{slug} instead.

parameters.name: csv
parameters.description: The new table as CSV, TSV or a markdown pipe table, header first.

parameters.name: json
parameters.description: The new table as JSON: {columns, rows}, an array of row objects, or an array of arrays with the header first.

400.description: Neither csv nor json parsed to a table.

404.description: No such page, or no table item on it.

get.description: Served by the plugin's own server, not the farm, for parity with wiki-plugin-json: GET /plugin/table/{slug} answers the first table item as JSON with CORS open; append .csv to the slug for text/csv.

200.description: The table as JSON, or CSV.

404.description: No such page, or no table item on it.

put.summary: json-plugin-style PUT — push data with an X-Api-Key
put.description: Served by the plugin's own server. Body is {columns, rows}, an array of rows, {csv: text} or raw text/csv; the X-Api-Key header must match a key in the site's status/plugin/table/tokens.json (see About Table API Keys). This is the door for scripts and agents on other machines that hold no owner cookie.

200.description: {status: ok, writes, interval, length, rows, columns}.

404.description: No such page, or no table item on it.
